import numpy as np
h = np.array([[0.0, 0.004, 0.0, 0.0], [0.004, 0.0181, 0.005, 0.0], [0.0, 0.005, 0.0355, 0.006],
              [0.0, 0.0, 0.006, 0.0521]])
w, v = np.linalg.eigh(h)
t = np.arange(0.0, 4001.0, 2.0)
c = (v * np.exp(-1j * np.outer(t, w))[:, None, :]) @ v[0]
p = np.abs(c) ** 2
assert np.allclose(nonparticipation_probability(p, 3)[::25], target)
